method: Supports exactly 9 or 18 holes and 1 through 4 players. Every hole has an editable integer par from 2 through 6, defaulting to 3. A hole score is blank or a strict whole number from 1 through 30; decimal, exponent and non-finite forms are rejected. Blank holes are excluded only from that player's entered-hole throw and par subtotals, and score to par is total throws minus par over those same entered holes. A player with no entered scores has no relative score. Names are trimmed, internal whitespace is collapsed, blank names fall back to Player N, and control characters or more than 30 characters are rejected. CSV export preserves blank cells, includes entered-hole throw/par subtotals and escapes quotes, commas and formula-like leading characters. Copy and download are generated from the same calculated result. Nothing is stored or transmitted; penalty throws must be included in the applicable hole score, and incomplete cards are not official totals.

sources.title: Professional Disc Golf Association, Official Rules of Disc Golf, 808 Scoring
